input_messages.content: Hi! I'd like to book a one-way flight from ORD to PHL on May 26. I want to book the exact same flight I took recently on May 10 from ORD to PHL. Could you help me with that?
Sure, my user ID is sophia_silva_7557.

Thanks for the details. I want to book for myself and one extra passenger, Kevin Smith, born April 12, 2001. Please book both in economy, with aisle and middle seats together if possible. I don't have any checked bags, and I don't want travel insurance. For payment, I want to use only one of my travel certificates. If the total price is above $500, please drop Kevin and book only for me.
Yes, please go ahead and book this flight for both of us using the $500 travel certificate.
No, that's all for now. Thank you very much for your help! ###STOP###
